summary.description: Two to four sentences in Simplified Chinese on the correctness of the reviewed code.

coverage_notes.description: Simplified Chinese. What was read in full, what was only skimmed, and what could not be verified statically.

title.description: One line in Simplified Chinese that states the wrong behaviour.

file.description: Repo-relative path of the root cause.

line.description: Line of the root cause in the current working tree.

description.description: Simplified Chinese. What the code does, what it should do, and why the difference matters.

trigger_scenario.description: Simplified Chinese. Concrete inputs, state, and ordering of events, and what the user or operator observes.

evidence.description: Code excerpts or a reasoning chain with path:line references that prove the trigger is reachable. For an uncertain finding, also what is unverified.

suggested_fix.description: Simplified Chinese. The direction of the fix, not a full patch.

suggested_test.description: Simplified Chinese. A test that fails before the fix.

reason.description: One sentence in Simplified Chinese on why verification refuted it.
